messages:
marta: Quick sync on Playground UI: I'm exploring a slim right-rail for streaming controls instead of per-message buttons. Goal: reduce visual noise while keeping actions reachable. Prototype: https://figma.com/s/stream-rail-proto — thoughts? :sparkles:
kevin: Love declutter. Two concerns: discoverability for pause/resume if we go icon-only, and where Regenerate lives. If regenerate stays as a text button in the message, controls feel split.
eli: UX idea: keep 'Regenerate' as the primary inline CTA but add a persistent mini-toolbar in the rail with icons for Pause, Tokens, and Quick Prompts. The rail can be collapsed by default.
jamie: Accessibility checklist: rail must be in tab order, icons need accessible names, and any state change should trigger a polite aria-live update. For pause/resume, aria-pressed and an announcement like 'Generation paused at 120 tokens' is helpful.
dennis: Backend compatibility: pause just toggles our existing stream gate; regenerate should call the same endpoint with `reseed=true`. Important edge case: if paused mid-stream and user hits regenerate, we should abort old stream and start fresh. Recommend explicit UX copy so users aren't confused.
marta: Agreed. Proposed microcopy: tooltip on pause icon: 'Pause streaming — resume where it left off'; regenerate tooltip: 'Regenerate — start over'. We'll also add a brief coachmark for first-time users: 'Pause freezes output so you can inspect early responses.'\en: Kevin: Minor copy note: 'Regenerate' vs 'Retry' — 'Regenerate' emphasises new content, 'Retry' implies same attempt. Prefer 'Regenerate'.
jamie: Token counter placement: propose the rail shows a compact token chip (e.g., 'tokens • 520'). Clicking the chip opens a popover with a breakdown (prompt / completion / cached) and two tabs: Breakdown / Prompt library. Keep popover absolutely positioned to avoid reflow during streaming.
dennis: Implementation detail: popover should be ephemeral and avoid re-rendering the whole message stream. Use portal + absolute positioning. Cache breakdown results on open to avoid spamming token accounting.
eli: Interaction nuance: users may expect the token chip click to open prompt quick-insert. Let's make the chip primary open the breakdown, and a small chevron affordance to jump to prompt library. On mobile, long-press could surface both options.\amarta: Visual states: when streaming is active, the pause icon animates subtly; when paused, icon shows a filled state and the rail gets a subtle accent. If streaming errors, show a tiny error dot with hover text.
kevin: A/B idea: test icon-only pause vs icon+label on hover for 2 weeks with 5% traffic to measure missed interactions and help rate. Also log whether users click the coachmark.
jamie: A11y action items I'll own: keyboard focus flows, ARIA attributes, live region examples; sample SR text: 'Playground generation: 3 of 12 chunks. Streaming. Tokens: 312.' And on pause: 'Streaming paused at token 312.'
dennis: Edge-case: user pauses, navigates away, then returns. Ensure resume token state is preserved for the session but invalidate if model or prompt changed. We'll add session-scoped resume tokens.
eli: Microcopy tweak: use verbs consistently. 'Pause'/'Resume' for streaming; 'Regenerate' for fresh output; avoid 'Stop' which sounds destructive.
ux-bot: Accessibility scan: suggested color adjustments. Pause icon on light bg fails contrast at small sizes. Recommend 1) increase icon stroke to 2px or 2) use darker pigment.
deploy-bot: Prototype deploy window: 3325100000-3325180000. Ping if we need earlier slot.
marta: Recap + owners: Jamie -> A11y spec & SR text; Dennis -> popover implementation + portal approach; Kevin -> copy + AB plan; Eli -> finalize layout variants in figma and produce collapsed/expanded states. Target: interactive prototype by Thu COB.
kevin: 👍 Will add telemetry points: rail open, pause, resume, regenerate, prompt quick-insert.
marta: Thanks — will post updated frames and link the prototype when ready.
